name: JD Woodworking
old_description: A true devotion to the craft stems from an intense satisfaction of turning conception into reality. I founded JDWOODWORKING in 2000 as a platform to showcase and sell quality handmade products. Sometimes in today’s modern world we can forget the beauty in the natural, beautiful, and handmade. Get in touch to start your project today.
about:
JD Woodworking operates from Las Vegas, Nevada. The founder reports launching the venture in 2000 as a platform to showcase and sell handmade wood products, though the business was formally started in 2016 after years of personal designing, building, and repairing. The company appears to be a sole proprietorship; no founder name is disclosed.

The shop produces one-of-a-kind handmade wood items including state and country flags, wall decor, holiday decorations, custom furniture repair, and a variety of cutting boards — endgrain, personalized, and patterned with species such as black walnut, cherry, and maple. Operations are described as a small-scale craft workshop; no facility size, headcount, or production volumes are provided.

The customer base consists of individual consumers seeking custom wood gifts, home decor, and furniture repair services. No specific industries or commercial clients are mentioned in the available materials.

The founder cites a devotion to craft and the satisfaction of turning conception into reality as the driving force, emphasizing integrity, reliability, and professionalism. The business positions its pieces as original, built to last, and a reminder of the beauty in natural, handmade goods.
